body: ADR 0001 HUNK ANNOUNCEMENT for bd-01M15TBYEHT8DDWZSYJFPGQCPZ: I will add exactly one paragraph-disjoint D6 bullet beside the existing receipt-identity rules. It will state that chart-processing adapters own a mandatory no-default receipt context; source/query/composite sensitivity joins by maximum; Public/Public alone may remain plain; non-public missing key fails before compute/cache/receipt; classification never changes proposition identity; and the architecture reopens only on the two ratified signals. No other ADR text and no source files.
